question: Who was the head of the committee of the Draft National Education Policy (NEP) 2019? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Shakila T Shamsu
MK Sridhar
Vasudha Kamat
K Kasturirangan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is K Kasturirangan

Explanation:
The head of the committee for the Draft National Education Policy (NEP) 2019 was Dr. K. Kasturirangan. He is a renowned Indian space scientist and former chairman of ISRO. This committee drafted the new education policy, which was approved by the government in 2020. NEP 2020 includes major reforms such as the 5+3+3+4 school structure replacing the 10+2 system and a 4-year undergraduate program in higher education. The Kasturirangan Committee emphasized a holistic and multidisciplinary approach to education.

question: Which of the following is NOT a correct pair of a country and its capital? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 2)

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा देश और उसकी राजधानी का सही जोड़ा नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 2)

कजाकिस्तान की राजधानी अस्ताना (अब नूर-सुल्तान) है, जबकि बिश्केक किर्गिस्तान की राजधानी है। शेष तीन जोड़े सही हैं: बाहामास की राजधानी नासाउ, लीबिया की राजधानी त्रिपोली, और बेल्जियम की राजधानी ब्रुसेल्स है। यह प्रश्न देशों और उनकी राजधानियों के ज्ञान पर आधारित है, जो सामान्य जागरूकता का महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है। कजाकिस्तान मध्य एशिया का सबसे बड़ा देश है, जबकि किर्गिस्तान भी मध्य एशिया में स्थित है।

question: Name the first person to take a solo flight from Mumbai to karachi in 1931. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Nelson Mandela
JRD Tata
CNR Rao
Satyajit Ray
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is JRD Tata

Explanation:
In 1931, JRD Tata undertook a daring solo flight from Mumbai to Karachi, marking a significant milestone in the history of Indian aviation. At that time, aviation technology was in its infancy, and long-distance flights were extremely risky. JRD Tata is regarded as the father of Indian aviation. He founded Air India (originally Tata Airlines) in 1932. His solo flight demonstrated his courage and vision, paving the way for commercial aviation in India.
question_hi: 1931 में मुंबई से कराची तक सोलो फ्लाइट करने वाले पहले व्यक्ति का नाम बताएं। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/03/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: नेल्सन मंडेला
जे.आर.डी. टाटा
सी.एन.आर. राव
सत्यजीत रे
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है जे.आर.डी. टाटा

Explanation:
1931 में जे.आर.डी. टाटा ने मुंबई से कराची तक अकेले विमान उड़ान भरने का साहसिक कार्य किया। यह भारतीय विमानन के इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर था, क्योंकि उस समय विमानन तकनीक प्रारंभिक अवस्था में थी और लंबी दूरी की उड़ानें बेहद जोखिम भरी होती थीं। जे.आर.डी. टाटा को भारतीय विमानन का जनक माना जाता है। उन्होंने 1932 में एयर इंडिया की स्थापना की, जो मूल रूप से टाटा एयरलाइंस थी। उनका सोलो फ्लाइट का यह कारनामा उनकी बहादुरी और दूरदर्शिता को दर्शाता है। इस उपलब्धि ने भारत में वाणिज्यिक विमानन की नींव रखी।

question: 'Not all animals migrate by choice' is a campaign launched by the: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: ESGP
WCCB
AWDF
IPCC
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is WCCB

Explanation:
This campaign was launched by the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB), a statutory body under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India. The campaign aims to raise awareness against wildlife trafficking and illegal trade. It highlights that many animals are forced to migrate due to human activities such as habitat destruction and climate change. WCCB plays a crucial role in enforcing the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972 and coordinating with international agencies to combat wildlife crimes.

question: How much money will a farmer get annually as per the PM-KISAN samman nidhi launched by the central Government? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: ₹5000
₹6000
₹7000
₹8000
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ₹6000

Explanation:
The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme was launched on 24 February 2019. Under this, eligible farmers receive an annual financial assistance of ₹6000. This amount is transferred in three instalments of ₹2000 every four months directly to farmers' bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The scheme aims to provide income support to small and marginal farmers to meet their agricultural and household needs. Eligibility requires the farmer to own cultivable land. The annual amount is fixed at ₹6000, not ₹5000, ₹7000, or ₹8000.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the annual assistance under PM-KISAN? → ₹6000
☛ How much is given per instalment? → ₹2000
☛ When was the scheme launched? → 24 February 2019
☛ What is the mode of transfer? → DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer)
☛ Who are the beneficiaries? → Small and marginal farmers

question: The Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India has designed an education portal named: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: EDUCATION
NIOS
NCERT
SAKSHAT
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is SAKSHAT

Explanation:
The education portal designed by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (now Ministry of Education) of the Government of India is SAKSHAT. It is an initiative under the National Educational Technology Forum (NETF), launched in 2018. The portal aims to promote digital education and provide online educational resources to all students. SAKSHAT stands for 'Students Access to Knowledge and Skills through Advanced Technology'. It hosts courses, e-books, and video lectures for various levels. Among the other options, NIOS and NCERT are educational bodies but not portals. EDUCATION is a generic term.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Which ministry launched the SAKSHAT portal? → Ministry of Education (formerly MHRD)
☛ What is the full form of SAKSHAT? → Students Access to Knowledge and Skills through Advanced Technology

☛ Which portal provides e-resources for digital education? → SAKSHAT
☛ What type of resources does SAKSHAT portal provide? → Courses, e-books, video lectures
question_hi: भारत सरकार के मानव संसाधन विकास मंत्रालय द्वारा डिजाइन किया गया शिक्षा पोर्टल का नाम क्या है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/03/2021) Shift 2)

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है SAKSHAT

Explanation:

question: What is the full form of BHIM? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (15/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Bharat Intraface for Money
Bheem Intraface for Mobile
Bharat Interface for Money
Bheem Interface for Mobile
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bharat Interface for Money

Explanation:
The full form of BHIM is Bharat Interface for Money. It is a UPI-based payment app developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). Named after Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, BHIM allows users to make direct transactions from their bank accounts. It was launched in December 2016 to promote digital payments after demonetization. The app is available on both Android and iOS platforms, requiring only a mobile number and bank account to operate. Other options like 'Intraface' or 'Bheem' are incorrect.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of BHIM? → Bharat Interface for Money
☛ Who developed BHIM? → NPCI
☛ BHIM is based on which payment system? → UPI (Unified Payments Interface)
☛ When was BHIM launched? → December 2016
☛ Who is BHIM named after? → Dr. B. R. Ambedkar

question: How many basic elements (Tatvas) have been described by early Indian philosophers to classify matter?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (14/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: Five
Six
Three
Nine
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Five

Explanation:
In ancient Indian philosophy, especially in Samkhya and Vaisheshika schools, matter is classified into five basic elements known as Panchamahabhuta. These are: Earth (solid), Water (liquid), Fire (energy), Air (gas), and Ether/Space (Akasha). These elements are considered the fundamental building blocks of all physical matter. The Vaisheshika school also accepts these five elements, with Akasha being eternal and all-pervading. This classification system is foundational to ancient Indian scientific thought and later influenced systems like Ayurveda. Thus, early Indian philosophers described five basic elements to classify matter.

question: The Suez Canal, which is very significant for commerce, was constructed in which of the following countries? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Brazil
Argentina
Oman
Egypt
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Egypt

Explanation:
The Suez Canal is an artificial sea-level waterway in Egypt, connecting the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea. Constructed between 1859 and 1869 under the leadership of French engineer Ferdinand de Lesseps, it serves as a crucial maritime route for commerce between Asia and Europe, eliminating the need to navigate around Africa. The canal is approximately 193.30 kilometers long and is one of the world's busiest waterways. In 1956, Egyptian President Gamal Abdel Nasser nationalized the canal, leading to the Suez Crisis. The canal is a vital source of revenue for Egypt and a key geopolitical asset.

question: What is the name of the intergovernmental military alliance between 30 European and North American countries? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (31/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: The International Military Collaboration
The World Militia Organization
The International Military Fund
The North Atlantic Treaty Organization
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is The North Atlantic Treaty Organization

Explanation:
NATO, which stands for North Atlantic Treaty Organization, is an intergovernmental military alliance between 30 European and North American countries. It was established on April 4, 1949, with the signing of the North Atlantic Treaty in Washington, D.C. The core principle of NATO is collective defense, as outlined in Article 5, which states that an attack on one member is an attack on all. NATO's headquarters are located in Brussels, Belgium. The alliance aims to ensure military cooperation and collective security among its members.

question: Which of the following cities is famous for the Kalighat paintings?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (24/07/2021) Shift 2)
options: Banaras
Kolkata
Nathdwara
Madurai
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kolkata

Explanation:
Kalighat painting is a style of folk painting that originated in the 19th century around the Kalighat Temple in Kolkata. It evolved from the traditional Pattachitra style, where artists used handmade paper and watercolors. The paintings primarily featured Hindu deities, especially Goddess Kali, along with social and everyday scenes. Known for their simple, flowing lines, vibrant colors, and satirical expressions, Kalighat paintings were popular in Kolkata before the rise of the Bengal School of Art. They are considered a precursor to modern Indian art. The art form declined in the early 20th century but remains a significant part of India's cultural heritage.

☛ From which traditional art style did Kalighat painting evolve? → Pattachitra
☛ What medium is used in Kalighat paintings? → Handmade paper and watercolors
